items.title: A.J. Brown: Inefficient with 10 targets in return
items.text:
Brown secured three of 10 targets for 27 yards in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets on Sunday and fumbled once but recovered.

items.title: Zay Flowers: Six catches in Week 6 loss
items.text:
Flowers brought in six of 11 targets for 66 yards and rushed once for one yard in the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Derrick Henry: Stymied by Browns in loss
items.text:
Henry rushed 17 times for 58 yards and brought in his only target for two yards in the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.title: Javonte Williams: Scores again in Week 6 defeat
items.text:
Williams rushed 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for nine yards in Sunday's 23-13 loss to the Packers.

items.title: Dak Prescott: Late TD not enough in Week 6 loss
items.text:
Prescott completed 34 of 54 passes for 258 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 23-13 loss to the Packers. He also rushed twice for seven yards.
